summary: Enspira Financial is a relationship-based advisory accounting firm and Allinial Global member with offices in Brookvale and Lindfield (Sydney), led by CEO Craig Stanmore. The Melbourne practice listed in our data (607 Bourke St) left in July 2025 and now trades as Guava Lane, so the Melbourne address is stale. Enspira runs an outsourced CFO service, virtual management accounting and bookkeeping that includes reconciling across Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks, and appointed Tom Sargent as Partner in July 2026.

first.subject: Reconciling behind Enspira's CFO service
first.body:
Hi Craig,

You've said that accessing specialist skills and a trusted process is key to systemising a business. Enspira's CFO Service pairs every client with a CFO and a Finance Manager, and your bookkeeping team codes bank feeds and reconciles across Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks. That month-end reconciling sits under every dashboard the CFO presents. I built Vert to turn hours of manual reconciliation into minutes, with a traceable audit trail instead of auto-coding that guesses. How much of your Finance Managers' month goes on reconciling?

Best,
Dawoud
